messages.subject: An error has occurred: The application exited unexpectedly.  Error writing response.
parts:
I'm receiving the following error on my Shiny app:

An error has occurred

The application exited unexpectedly.

connect EAGAIN

Loading required package: slam Using the GLPK callable library version 4.50 Listening on domain socket /tmp/shiny-session/ab575a14fa20ec27faf3121b8de30b9e.sock Error writing response: -1


For whatever reason, the error appears intermittently, but other times the app works fine.

Any ideas?

Thanks in advance!

messages.subject: Re: An error has occurred: The application exited unexpectedly. Error writing response.
parts:
We recently switched the way we communicate between Shiny Server and Shiny, to use Unix domain sockets instead of the normal way (TCP connections). When testing under load we've found Unix domain sockets to be less stable after all, so we've gone back to TCP connections--this should be deployed glimmer and spark on Friday of this week. It should fix this problem.

Sorry for the inconvenience. If you're seeing this happen quite a lot, then please let us know.
